deities: Lord Shiva as Chandreshwar/Bhutnath (linga; local lore calls it swayambhu)

history.period: Attributed to c. 1050 CE (verify); popular lore claims Bhoja-era or ~2500-year antiquity — weakly sourced
history.summary: Ancient hilltop Shiva temple atop Chandranath Hill above Paroda village, Quepem taluka. Built of grey laterite in Indo-Aryan Nagara style with a curvilinear shikhara (inheritage.foundation); the mandapa columns show possible Vijayanagara influence. Local lore holds that moonbeams fall on the linga at full moon and that the linga exudes water droplets under moonlight — unverified. Visitor accounts note old wooden statues and carvings inside. Exact construction date is uncertain; treat the 1050 CE Kadamba attribution and the Bhoja-king lore as provisional. name: Shri Chandreshwar Bhutnath Temple
town_description: Paroda is a village in Quepem taluka, South Goa, about 15 km from Margao amid forested hills; the Chandreshwar temple stands atop Chandranath Hill above the village, with views over the surrounding countryside.

travel.road: Paroda village, Quepem taluka (403705); motorable road leads up Chandranath Hill to the temple

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; full-moon nights are considered auspicious per local lore
visitor_information.opening_hours: 06:00-21:00 per the Justdial listing for the Paroda temple — verify locally
